supporting_evidence.summary: significant deviations in scope [all services]: productcatalogservice_latency-90 z=950.28 (4751.4%); frontend_latency-50 z=589.51 (2947.5%); productcatalogservice_latency-50 z=530.03 (2650.2%); recommendationservice_latency-90 z=463.42 (2317.1%)
traces for productcatalogservice: SIGNIFICANT change; own spans self-time p50 0.01->0.01ms (1.27x), errors 0.0->0.0; inbound calls self-time p50 2.4->202.94ms (84.7x), errors 0.0->0.0

alternatives_rejected.why: Its own span self-time is essentially unchanged (0.01->0.01ms, 1.27x) while caller-observed latency rose 84.7x. Saturation would slow its own processing; added time on the wire is not explained by CPU (E2).

Its latency-90 deviation (z=463) is about half of productcatalogservice's (z=950). This fits recommendationservice inheriting latency from its downstream productcatalog calls rather than causing it (E1).

Frontend latency-50 (z=590) is smaller than productcatalogservice's top deviation (E1). Callers of productcatalogservice see a large inbound latency jump (E2), so frontend is a victim, not the source.

proposed_fix.description: Inspect the productcatalogservice pod's network path, for example `tc qdisc show` on its interface. Remove any injected netem delay rule. Confirm that caller-observed p50 latency returns to about 2-3ms.
